title: Probability at length zero
statement: Let $D$ be a natural number and let $A$ be a predicate on finite sequences of symbols from an alphabet of size $D$. The probability assigned to $A$ on sequences of length zero is $1$ if $A$ holds for the empty sequence, and $0$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a predicate on sequences over an alphabet of size $D$
